hero.heading: About MAA Saraswati Veterinary Hospital
hero.subheading: A free veterinary hospital serving animals with compassion and modern medicine since July 2024.

story.heading: How It All Began
story.p1: MAA Saraswati Veterinary Hospital was inaugurated in July 2024 with a singular mission: to provide free, high-quality veterinary care to every animal in need. Located in Hyderabad, Telangana, our hospital serves the twin cities and surrounding areas within a 100 km radius.
story.p2: We treat a wide range of conditions including digestive disorders, respiratory illnesses, skin diseases, urinary problems, reproductive issues, poisoning cases, fever, mineral and vitamin deficiencies, and orthopaedic injuries.
story.p3: Our team of dedicated veterinarians and support staff work tirelessly to ensure that no animal suffers due to lack of medical attention or financial constraints. We believe every animal deserves compassionate, professional care.

ambulance.heading: 24/7 Ambulance Service
ambulance.text: Our ambulance service covers the twin cities of Hyderabad and Secunderabad, extending up to 100 km for emergency animal rescues and medical transport.

hero.heading: State-of-the-Art Infrastructure
hero.subheading: Modern facilities equipped to provide the best veterinary care.

facilities.heading: World-Class Veterinary Facilities
facilities.labDesc: Fully equipped diagnostic laboratory for blood tests, urinalysis, and pathological examinations.
facilities.otDesc: Modern, sterile operation theatre for all surgical procedures with advanced anaesthesia equipment.
facilities.wardsDesc: Spacious, climate-controlled wards for post-operative care and recovery with round-the-clock monitoring.
facilities.ambulanceDesc: Fully equipped ambulance service covering the twin cities and up to 100 km radius for emergency rescues.
facilities.icuDesc: Intensive care and observation unit for critical cases requiring continuous medical attention.

hero.heading: Medical Facilities
hero.subheading: Comprehensive veterinary care for all animals.

animals.heading: Animal Categories
animals.cattleDesc: Cows, buffaloes, and other bovines — digestive, respiratory, reproductive, and orthopaedic care.
animals.dogsDesc: All breeds — vaccinations, surgeries, skin treatments, and emergency care.
animals.sheepDesc: Small ruminant healthcare including deworming, wound care, and disease management.
animals.poultryDesc: Poultry health management, disease prevention, and treatment.
animals.birdsDesc: Avian healthcare including injury treatment and disease management.
animals.pigsDesc: Swine healthcare, vaccinations, and disease treatment.

surgery.heading: Surgery Capabilities
surgery.text: Our hospital is equipped with a modern operation theatre capable of performing a wide range of surgical procedures including emergency surgeries, orthopaedic corrections, tumour removals, and reproductive surgeries.

lab.heading: Laboratory Services
lab.text: Our in-house diagnostic laboratory provides quick and accurate results for blood tests, urinalysis, faecal examinations, and skin scrapings, enabling prompt diagnosis and treatment.
